cause: The payment service is running and healthy but rejects every charge request with an 'Invalid token' error raised in its own charge handler. checkout fails as a consequence.

evidence.claim: payment logs the same failure on every charge, 13 times.
The deepest erroring span in the error traces is the charge span inside payment.
payment error rate is 100% while its latency is low.
payment is running and healthy with no restarts.

alternatives_considered.why_rejected: It is running, healthy and has restart_count 0.

limitations: The source of the invalid token is not visible in the telemetry.
